newsitem.title: USA: Envirodyne unit develops casing technology.
newsitem.headline: Envirodyne unit develops casing technology.

text.p: Envirodyne Industries Inc said Monday its Viskase subsidiary has developed a new process to make cellulose casings for hot dogs and sausages.
The new technology is expected to have "a significant impact on Envirodyne's future profitability," the company said.
A production unit is under construction and will begin full production in late 1998, Envirodyne said. A conversion to the process will begin after the first line is complete.

Envirodyne expects to make "significant" capital investment to convert all Viskase's production capacity to the new process, and funding for the conversion will be considered when the company refinances its debt in 1999.
